auditor_jane: Hi team — for SOC2 evidence we need traceability that ties RBAC role changes to approvals, deployment/apply records, and cloud audit log entries. Also please point to any linked vuln triage or incident notes for role changes in the last 12 months. What minimal artifact set do you recommend?

chris: Sure. We'll provide three artifact types: 1) PR + approval records (GitHub links and reviewer/approver) 2) CI/CD apply job records + terraform plan/apply logs 3) Audit log exports (cloud IAM/KMS) and a manifest. Will outline examples below.

samir: To be explicit: our trace is PR -> CI review -> terraform apply job -> cloud audit log entry. Example PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4823 (approved by @leo).

leo: @auditor_jane PR and apply timestamps for that change: merged 2025-11-04T15:23Z, terraform apply job id infra-apply-20251104-72 (CI link: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/infra-apply/72). Cloud audit log entry id: projects/redwood-prod/logs/iam/entries/1598732.

chris: SIEM query you can use in Splunk to pull the IAM SetIamPolicy events for the window:
```
index=cloud_audit sourcetype=google:cloud:iam action="SetIamPolicy" resource_type="project" earliest=-12mon
| table _time, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.request.resource, protoPayload.request.requestId
| sort -_time
```
We'll export matching entries to s3://redwood-audit-evidence/2025/rbac/exports/infra-4823.json (default retention = 365d).

leo: KMS linkage: when terraform applied we record envelope key id in parameter store and KMS audit logs. Example KMS entry: keyName=projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/prod-enc, rotation_event_id=key-rot-20251101-4. Cloud KMS logs include cryptoKeyVersion and requestId.

samir: For vuln triage — there was a low-sev config drift in that rollout window, tracked as VULN-2025-789. Triage notes and timeline are in vuln tracker: https://github.com/redwood-internal/vuln-tracker/issues/89. No customer impact, mitigated same day.

chris: Incident cross-ref: INC-2026-007 is the only role-change-related incident in the last 12 months. Postmortem link: https://redwood-internal/wiki/incidents/INC-2026-007. TL;DR: accidental over-permissive role merged -> rollback + key rotation + enhanced CI gating. We'll include the incident timeline and proof of remediation.

evidence-bot: Packaging started: creating archive at s3://redwood-audit-evidence/2026/audits/auditor_jane-evidence-6161619999.tar.gz. ETA ~10m :package:
- includes: infra PRs (md), terraform plan/apply logs (txt), cloud audit exports (json), KMS export (json), GH approvals screenshot (png), manifest (yaml).

auditor_jane: Thanks. Can you confirm export retention policy and whether the exported logs include request IDs for forensic reconstruction / replay?

chris: Retention on S3 auditor exports is 365 days by default; we can extend on request. Cloud audit entries include protoPayload.request.requestId and authenticationInfo.principalEmail. Splunk exports preserve requestId. We'll set include_request_id=true in the manifest.

leo: KMS decrypt/encrypt audit logs also contain the principal, cryptoKeyVersion, and requestId. If you need signed timestamps or a checksum manifest for nondisrepudiation, we can add a SHA256 manifest file for the bundle.

auditor_jane: Great — please add a simple manifest that lists each file, source (GH/CI/cloud), time window, and proof links. Also please assign a single POC for the handoff and a short walkthrough.

samir: I'm the POC. I'll DM you the handoff checklist and schedule a 20-min walkthrough tomorrow 14:00 PT. I'll include the manifest and signed checksum.

auditor_jane: Perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
